Tariq (ops): RCA published: https://redwood.internal/rca/2923456789 — short summary + actions below. Please skim and ack. :eyes:
Faye (finance): Quick TL;DR for finance: unexpected billing spike due to aggressive cache warmup during rollover — cost delta ~18% for the day. Need timeline for customer / accounting.
Liam (infra): Root cause section covers the warmup heuristic plus a rollout config that enabled parallel prefetch across nodes, causing duplicated tokenization + model-init work.
Tariq (ops): Skim highlights (copied):
```
Impact window: 2026-05-09 22:05–22:42 UTC
Symptoms: elevated CPU/GPU utilization and duplicated outbound requests during node rollover
Scope: hosted API traffic in apac-sg cluster (~6% of traffic)
Mitigation: disabled parallel-prefetch flag and limited warmup concurrency at 22:28 UTC
Customer notice: internal draft in ops docs, awaiting finance sign-off
```
Olga (eng): Action items (owner — due):
- Liam: add a rollout guard that disables parallel-prefetch by default and a preflight check (PR + CI) — due 2026-05-14.
- Tariq: publish external-facing impact summary + coordinate with billing for customer credits — due 2026-05-12 noon PT.
- Olga: add synthetic replay test for node-rollover warmup scenario to CI — due 2026-05-20.
- Faye: produce cost impact breakdown and recommended customer credit approach — due 2026-05-12 EOD.
- Priya: schedule office hours to triage actions and sign off on customer messaging — 2026-05-11 09:00 PT (invite soon).
NotifierBot: Draft external note is available for review: https://redwood.internal/drafts/billing-spike-2923456789

Faye (finance): I'll draft the accounting summary and proposed credit tiers. Tariq — please include the customer timeline in the external note.
Tariq (ops): Will do. I'll paste the customer timeline into the draft by 2026-05-11 08:00 PT.
Liam (infra): I'll open the rollout-guard PR today and tag Olga for CI tests.
Olga (eng): For the replay test I'll capture the exact preload sequence that caused duplication and post the test plan here by 2026-05-15.
Priya (ops lead): Office hours: 2026-05-11 09:00 PT — link: https://calendar.internal/redwood/event/rca-2923456789-review. Please bring any open questions.
